svg.title: SayItLocally
svg.desc: A speech bubble releases several translucent streams of light in violet, blue, cyan and gold; they weave, cross and merge as they drift across the banner, with gold glints sparking where they meet. They settle as lines of words on a translucent page, where small glints still flicker: the developer's own record to verify the past and guide the future, kept on their machine, never shared.

g.text: Your words: verify the past, guide the future — kept private.
說出重要的話，留作自己的紀錄：驗證過去，指引未來，不外流。
